Research dependency notices

Nefarius Injector v1.5.0
Upstream: https://github.com/nefarius/Injector/tree/v1.5.0
Asset: https://github.com/nefarius/Injector/releases/download/v1.5.0/Injector_x86_amd64_arm64.zip
SHA256: ae8729976ae97cc068813ec67981833f26cf92b5cde0ffe16c01b7b44e346a38
License: MIT; complete upstream text retained in Injector/LICENSE.
Downloaded binaries live in ignored .deps, outside tracked source.
Run tools/dependencies/Get-ResearchDependencies.ps1 explicitly to download them.
Injector is a generic research loader. The wrapper restricts its use to exact
GameInput binaries. Security software may flag remote-thread injection.

Microsoft Detours v4.0.1
Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/Detours/tree/v4.0.1
Pinned commit: e4bfd6b03e50de46b47abfbd1e46b384f0c5f833
License: MIT; complete upstream text retained in Detours/LICENSE.md.
Probe build/dependency pinning is defined by the native build configuration.
Both original notices must accompany redistributed dependencies and builds.

Local Detours modification: cmake/Detours.cmake applies an exact allocation-only
patch to DetourThread and DetourOperation in the build tree. Their class new/delete
use VirtualAlloc/VirtualFree instead of the process CRT heap. This avoids waiting
for a process-heap lock held by a suspended target thread. Patch operations are
prepared before suspension. The upstream checkout remains unchanged; the bounded
heap-lock regression test exercises allocation and commit under this condition.
